finding: A published 1723 Marblehead town marriage entry names James Beveridge and Sarah Bennett. A 1724 birth names the mother Sarah but not her maiden surname; the exact mother identification must be traced in the original registers.
limitations: Sarah Bennett as mother of this recorded child is a contextual inference, not a uniquely named mother on the birth entry; Sarah Holman appears in a later James marriage report.

finding: Brunswick's February 1748/9 entry names James Beveridge and Jean White of Georgetown as parties declaring marriage intention. It does not document solemnization or unique identities of the parties.
limitations: The online profile attaches a spouse relationship on legacy evidence, but an intention is not a marriage certificate; also unknown whether either participant corresponds to the named 1724 Marblehead-born person or her named McKinney family.
